name: Avakas Gorge
description: A limestone gorge on the Akamas peninsula that narrows to about three metres with 30m walls and a chockstone wedged overhead. You walk up the streambed. In spring there's water in it and in August there isn't.
getting: Rough track from Agios Georgios — a normal hire car makes the car park but only just. Two hours in and out. Do not go in or after rain; it floods.
